newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid speculative buying by individuals, dealers said.
"The market was oversold and the rise is just a technical recovery," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 5.33 points to close at 1,538.38 at 0920 GMT. Losers led gainers 196 to 79.
Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.75 rupees to 35.50 rupees and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 310.
